I did not understand that. Try: status, modules, superuser, stealth, version, device, or ask for a joke.

Things I can answer offline:
· status — kernel, root, module and stealth overview
· modules — installed modules
· superuser — how many apps are granted
· stealth — kernel stealth and launcher icon state
· version — manager and kernel UAPI versions
· device — model, Android version and ABI
· stealth on / stealth off — ask to toggle it
· web manager — ask to start the local panel
· joke — another line
